text:
rachel: FYI CloudArc wants a private marketplace listing that bundles a 12mo commit + "hardware credit" redeemable with our OEM partner, plus a small SI onboarding pack. They also want a joint announcement slot in ~5 weeks. Can we agree on how the HW credit shows up on the PO and renewal mechanics?

omar: Ops: two options from infra side -- (A) marketplace applies the credit at checkout (needs partner integration, ETA 6-8 weeks), or (B) we show gross price and include a voucher metadata field that the partner redeems off-marketplace. (B) is fastest.

jen: Sales: prefer (A) since procurement likes net pricing. If (A) isn't ready timeline-wise, (B) is acceptable as long as the PO clearly states "estimated net after hardware credit" and includes voucher ID + redemption instructions. Field needs a visible savings line. :money_with_wings:

samir: Finance: prefer voucher as contra-revenue recorded outside marketplace (option B) to keep ARR clean. If we go with marketplace-applied credit (A) we need reconciliations and a monthly amortization schedule for the subsidy. Also require clawback language if commit not hit.

legal-bot: Legal: can support either flow. Requirements: voucher expiry (90 days from issue), non-transferable, recoupable per clawback schedule. For marketplace-applied credits, include audit rights for redemption events. For off-marketplace vouchers, include a representation that partner will deliver redemption reports within 30 days of redemption.

rachel: Renewal mechanics: propose 12mo term auto-renews unless 60-day opt-out. Add an early-renew accelerator: if customer signs renewal 45+ days early and moves up a tier, apply a one-time extra 3% off, capped at $40k. Thoughts?

omar: Ops: if we use preview listing for announcement we can mark "SI docs pending" and then flip to final on SI signoff. Require SI runbook URL in the offer metadata before final publish.

jen: Sales: early-renew accelerator sounds good. Also ask for a 60-day POC ramp credit (metered) up to $15k to help pilots. That should be recoupable if they don't reach commit.

samir: Finance: ok to allow a capped ramp credit, but define clawback: recoup 60% in month 1, 25% in month 2, 15% month 3 if commit not reached. Ramp credit amortized over 6 months if applied as subsidy.

legal-bot: I'll draft PO addendum language: voucher terms, ramp credit cap, clawback matrix, early-renew clause, and partner co-brand approval steps.

rachel: Ops request: marketplace metadata must include fields: sku, commit_amount, discount_tiers, voucher_id (nullable), voucher_redemption_flow (marketplace|partner), si_runbook_url (nullable), announcement_window. Omar will add to staging.

omar: Added draft to staging: po-cloudarc-4960001234 (preview). marketplace-bot: Reminder  review window opens in 48h.

jen: Let's lock announcement date provisional (T+35 days) and require final publish by T+28. If partner integration for credit isn't ready by T+21, we'll use voucher-off-marketplace path.

samir: I'll build the revenue recognition stub and share the spreadsheet by EOD.

rachel: Great. I'll collate legal + finance + ops checklists and circulate a single Notion link. tagging @omar @jen @samir. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
